tiers.req: Six Premium Runes and the first three rune sockets bought: the PRE runeword is active (3,600 gems).
All four Engineer Slot Upgrades bought (1,250 gems).
All 9 rune sockets bought (4,500 gems for the last six).
Hourglass Generator Speed at level 2 or more (550 gems).
Timeline Engine Speed at level 2 or more (650 gems).
Extra Rift Worker bought (700 gems), after the Golden Rift timeline upgrade.

tables.title: Gem rules
rows: Tiers follow the Gem Guide's buy order, except that Daily Fate Spiral (its #2) sits third here because it cannot be bought before Act 3, and the curio slots (its #9) sit fifth so they are bought by the time Curio expects them.
Buy three Premium Runes, then alternate: 4th rune and 1st socket, 5th rune and 2nd socket, 6th rune and 3rd socket.
Buy the remaining rune sockets as you build runewords.
Keep 900 gems saved before entering Act 3. A chest costs 80 gems, so the upgrade pays for itself in about 12 days.
Buy each Engineer Slot Upgrade as its resource unlocks.
The rest of the Upgrades tab can be skipped. Do not buy ash generation.
The daily quest gives 60 gems and many achievements pay 30.
A pet stat reroll costs 50 gems (Tier 5-6 pets only). A Class Reset Brew (talent reset) costs 30; prefer account boosts.

tables.title: Upgrade costs
rows: 300, 350, 400, 450, 500, 550 (6 of the 12 ranks, if the inventory starts at 10 slots)
